category: hosted feature flags and remote config

free_tier.stated: Free: up to 50,000 requests a month, 1 team member, 1 project, unlimited feature flags, environments, identities and segments, up to 100,000 users in experiments, API access
free_tier.notes: Only /flags, /identities, /traits and /environment-document count; one SDK instantiation that fetches flags is one request. Over the limit a free account is warned by email, and 7 days later the API stops answering until 30 days after the warning or an upgrade. Each project holds up to 1000 features and 500 segments.

per_object_cap.stated: a flag string value is at most 20,000 bytes and an identity trait value at most 2,000 bytes

retention.stated: unverified: no retention period for flags, identities or audit logs on the Free plan is stated on the pages read

egress.terms: not applicable: a flag service metered by request count; no traffic allowance is published

interface_detail: Flags API at https://edge.api.flagsmith.com/api/v1/ with a public Environment Key in the X-Environment-Key header (a GET /flags/ without a key answered 401); Management API with a secret Organisation API Token, 500 requests per minute.
tooling: Flagsmith SDKs or any HTTP client; the Management API covers everything the dashboard does.
chaining: Remote config and kill switches for a small app on free compute, fetched once per page view or session to stay inside 50,000 requests a month.

limits.value: flag string value 20,000 bytes; identity trait value 2,000 bytes

limits_note: 1 team member and 1 project on Free; 1000 features and 500 segments per project.
binding_note: A server-rendered page fetches flags once per view, so 50,000 views a month uses the allowance; past it the Flags API is blocked 7 days after the warning email.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for first name, last name, email address and a password, with no payment field; the sign-up page states a free for life plan.

reliability_note: On the Free plan the API stops answering after the plan limit is exceeded and the 7-day warning passes; the block clears 30 days after the warning or on upgrade. SDK requests are not rate limited.
confidence_note: Every value is quoted from the first-party pricing page, system limits, API docs and sign-up page; the Flags API host was probed and answered 401 without a key. A flag read with an Environment Key on a free account would move it to measured.
